153	class ActDecompositionUnionMemory(MemorySystem):
154	    """Per-act charging with system-side union and learned charge-count control."""
155	
156	    def __init__(self, llm: LLMCallable):
157	        super().__init__(llm)
158	        # charge predicted but absent from the truth -> times observed
159	        self.spurious: dict[str, int] = defaultdict(int)
160	        # charge that appeared in some truth -> times observed
161	        self.confirmed: dict[str, int] = defaultdict(int)
162	        # number of detected acts -> {number of true charges: times observed}
163	        self.size_by_acts: dict[int, dict[int, int]] = defaultdict(lambda: defaultdict(int))
164	        # every observed |truth|, for facts whose act count was never seen
165	        self.global_sizes: dict[int, int] = defaultdict(int)
166	        self._size_obs = 0
167	        # (act text, charge) style hints, most recent last
168	        self.examples: list[dict[str, str]] = []
169	        self._learned_items = 0
170	
171	    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
172	    # Learning — structural memory only; no string rewriting
173	    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
174	
175	    def learn_from_batch(self, batch_results: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> None:
176	        for r in batch_results:
177	            truth = _clean(_payload(r.get("ground_truth", "")))
178	            if not truth:
179	                continue
180	            truth_parts = [_clean(t) for t in _split_charges(truth)]
181	            truth_parts = [t for t in truth_parts if t]
182	            if not truth_parts:
183	                continue
184	            for t in truth_parts:
185	                self.confirmed[t] += 1
186	
187	            truth_set = set(truth_parts)
